subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Settle in the technical design (Q5) how a long-lived draft satisfies the memory gate's ancestry and evidence rules, including re-evidencing at the lock.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: The memory gate verifies record evidence against the landing tree and requires the mainline to be an ancestor, so a draft open across many rounds falls behind. The mechanism belongs to the technical design, not to the requirements.
fit_criterion: The technical design names the re-evidencing step, and a fixture draft that fell behind the mainline during its rounds passes the memory gate at its lock.
